preconditions: The deterministic verifier has produced invariant findings for the run
The Reality Diff for the run is available by reference
purpose: Explain verifier findings using cited trace events without changing any verdict
steps: Read each invariant finding and the events it cites
Relate the first divergence to the failed invariants
Explain the likely cause, citing event and finding identifiers
Return the interpretation; verdicts stay exactly as the verifier reported them
stop_conditions: Every failed invariant has a cited explanation
The evidence is insufficient and an unresolved question is recorded
